announcements.headline: Half Year Trading Update
announcements.insight: Peabody Capital issues a half-year trading update. This follows its March 2026 results and the October 2026 departure of the Chief Operating Officer.

announcements.headline: Departure of Chief Operating Officer
announcements.insight: The departure of the Chief Operating Officer represents a significant executive change. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details on leadership continuity.

announcements.headline: Annual Financial Report
announcements.insight: Peabody Capital PLC has published its Annual Financial Report, following the earlier release of unaudited results in June. This filing completes the annual reporting cycle for the year ended 31 March 2026.

announcements.headline: Annual Financial Report
announcements.insight: Peabody Capital PLC publishes its annual financial report following the June 2026 unaudited results. Shareholders should review these figures for detailed performance metrics.

announcements.headline: Unaudited results for the year ended 31 March 2026
announcements.insight: Peabody Capital PLC has published its annual results for the year ended 31 March 2026. Shareholders should review these figures to assess the company's financial position.
